policy: Record Image Compress only after the original English implementation is extracted byte-for-byte into one shared local owner, English and Swahili output parity is proved, every advertised codec and batch output reopens at exact dimensions, target-size behavior is bounded, mobile/accessibility/metadata pass, and no image or tool-data leaves the browser.

evidence.workflow: The pre-change English controller body is fingerprinted and extracted unchanged into the shared image-compress studio used by both languages; there is no fetch, XHR or WebSocket image path.
evidence.export: The coordinator reran 3/3 Chromium tests. Controlled PNGs were byte-identical; PNG, JPEG, WebP, auto selection, a 600x400 target-size JPEG, and both download-all WebPs reopened at exact dimensions. Invalid/clear, presets, reflow, themes, keyboard, contrast, SEO and no image/tool-data egress passed; consent-mode route telemetry was measured separately.
